page.heading: Skills
page.subtitle: Reusable review rules. One skill, many agents — each one costs tokens on every run that loads it.

empty.title: No skills yet
empty.body: A skill is a markdown rule your agents share — your team's standards, written once. Create one, or import a file.

selectPrompt.title: Select a skill
selectPrompt.body: Pick a skill on the left to preview its body.

create.title: Create skill
create.subtitle: A skill is a markdown rule your agents share. The body is the only text sent to the model.
create.defaultBody:
# Rule

Describe what the reviewer should flag, and what it should not.

config.title: Configuration
config.enabledHint: The master switch. A disabled skill loads for no agent.
config.name: Name
config.nameHint: Lowercase, hyphenated. This is the heading the model reads and the label in the run trace.
config.descriptionHint: The skill's interface — write it as a directive. “Flag new branches that no test asserts on”, not “Rules for tests”.
config.descriptionPlaceholder: Flag new branches that no test asserts on
config.bodyHint: The only text sent to the model. Editing the body is the entire skill — everything else is metadata.
config.snapshotHint: Saving a changed body snapshots it as v{version}.

danger.title: Delete skill
danger.body: Removes it from all agents. This can't be undone.
danger.confirmUsed: Delete "{name}"? It is loaded by {agents}. This can't be undone.

preview.title: Preview
preview.subtitle: Rendered as the reviewing agent receives it.
preview.vettingNotice: This skill was imported. Its body is someone else's instructions, and enabling it puts them in your agents' prompts. Read it before you turn it on.

versions.title: Version history
versions.subtitle: Every body change snapshots the text, so a past eval run stays reproducible against exactly what it scored.

import.title: Import skill
import.subtitle: Nothing is saved until you confirm.

ignored.title: Ignored — not read, not stored, not run
ignored.body: The importer opens exactly one markdown file. Everything else in the archive is listed here and was never opened.
ignored.none: Nothing else was in the upload.

adopt.title: What you are about to adopt
adopt.body: This text becomes instructions in your agents' prompts. Read it in full.

import.savesDisabled: Imported skills are saved disabled. Enable it once you have read it.
import.success: Imported "{name}" — disabled until you enable it.

listItem.vettingTitle: Imported and not yet enabled — read the body before you turn it on
